name: hnrie KDE Registry
description: Personal Kasm workspace registry featuring KDE Plasma desktops and Chromium.

workspaces.description: Chromium is a free and open-source browser, primarily developed and maintained by Google.
Complete KDE Neon: the official KDE-built Linux distribution running the latest KDE Plasma desktop on top of an Ubuntu LTS base, bundled with the full KDE application suite.
workspaces.notes: Official 'kdeneon/all' image - the complete KDE Neon experience with all KDE apps preinstalled. amd64 only. May need a KasmVNC wrapper for full Kasm integration.

workspaces.description: Full-featured Ubuntu KDE Plasma desktop with the complete LinuxServer.io toolset (browsers, file manager, productivity apps, dev utilities). Multi-arch (amd64 + arm64), updated daily.
workspaces.notes: Image is from LinuxServer.io webtop. Listens on port 3000 by default; you may need to map it to Kasm's 6901 or run with --network host. PUID/PGID env vars are typically required.

workspaces.description: Minimal KDE Plasma desktop image, built from KDE Neon. A lightweight Plasma environment with no extra applications - ideal for slim sessions or as a base for customisation.
workspaces.notes: Official 'kdeneon/plasma' image - minimal Plasma build. amd64 only. May require additional configuration to integrate with Kasm's KasmVNC (consider running through a wrapper).

workspaces.description: KDE Plasma desktop on Ubuntu Resolute (25.10) with Wayland. A modern, full-featured KDE desktop environment delivered through Kasm Workspaces.
